rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow and unanimous, affirming on full-scope enablement/undue experimentation without adopting categorical rules about functional genus claims. Barrett or Kagan are the next most likely authors given their central role in the conference themes (Morse/Holland Furniture anti-preemption and administrable §112(a) commensurability), with a modest chance of Gorsuch or Barrett writing separately to emphasize notice/separation-of-powers limits.
